detail: match op { OpAdd => if is_numeric(l) && is_numeric(r) { if l is TFloat || r is TFloat { Some(TFloat)} else if l is TUnion(_) || r is TUnion(_) { Some(ty_join(l, r))} else { Some(TInt)}} else if l is TStr && r is TStr { Some(TStr)} else if l is TList(_) && r is TList(_) { Some(l)} else { None} OpSub | OpMul | OpDiv | OpMod => if is_numeric(l) && is_numeric(r) { if l is TFloat || r is TFloat { Some(TFloat)} else { Some(TInt)}} else { None} OpEq | OpNe | OpLt | OpLe | OpGt | OpGe => { let ordered =(is_numeric(l) && is_numeric(r)) ||(l is TStr && r is TStr) let eq_ok = if op == OpEq || op == OpNe { ordered ||(l is TBool && r is TBool)} else { ordered} if eq_ok { Some(TBool)} else { None}} OpAnd | OpOr => if l is TBool && r is TBool { Some(TBool)} else { None} OpMatch => Some(TBool) OpPipe => Some(TUnknown) OpBitAnd | OpBitOr | OpBitXor | OpShl | OpShr => if l is TInt && r is TInt { Some(TInt)} else { None}}
